The framed motive of a point recovers the sphere spectrum

Animation for Theorem 11.9 in G. Garkusha & I. Panin, Framed motives of algebraic varieties (after V. Voevodsky), J. Amer. Math. Soc. 34 (2021), 261–313. Space bar: play/pause; arrow keys: previous/next scene.

Narration: synthetic voice, about 6 minutes. Use the CC button for subtitles.
The pictures are schematic: the affine line A1ℂ is drawn as the complex plane, and higher levels are drawn in oblique projection. All mathematical statements are taken from the paper; see Section 11 there for the proof. The voice is synthetic (Kokoro text-to-speech); the script is the text shown by the CC button.
